title.zh: 卷二 本紀第二 太宗
title.raw: 卷二 本紀第二 太宗 Volume 2 Annals 2: Taizong

sentences.zh: 太宗文武大聖大廣孝皇帝諱世民，高祖次子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong Wen Wu Great Sage Great Broad Filial, taboo name Shimin, was Gaozu's second son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong, posthumously honored as Wen Wu the Great Sage and Great Broadly Filial, bore the taboo name Shimin and was the second son of Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 母曰太穆皇后竇氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Taimu, née Dou.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Taimu of the Dou clan.

sentences.zh: 生而不驚。

translations.literal: At birth he did not startle.
translations.idiomatic: At birth he did not cry out.

sentences.zh: 方四歲，有書生謁高祖曰：「公在相法，貴人也，然必有貴子。

translations.literal: When he was four years old, a scholar called on Gaozu and said, "Your Excellency, by physiognomy, is a noble man, yet you must have a noble son."
translations.idiomatic: When he was four years old, a scholar called on Gaozu and said, "Your Excellency's features mark you as a man of rank, yet you must have a son who will surpass you in eminence."

sentences.zh: 」及見太宗，曰：「龍鳳之姿，天日之表，其年幾冠，必能濟世安民。

translations.literal: When he saw Taizong, he said, "Dragon-and-phoenix bearing, heaven-and-sun countenance; his years nearly at capping age—he will surely save the age and pacify the people."
translations.idiomatic: When he saw Taizong, he said, "He has the bearing of dragon and phoenix and a countenance like heaven and sun. His years are nearly at capping age; he will surely save the realm and bring peace to the people."

sentences.zh: 」書生已辭去，高祖懼其語泄，使人追殺之，而不知其所往，因以為神。

translations.literal: The scholar had already taken his leave; Gaozu feared his words would leak out and sent men to pursue and kill him, but did not know where he had gone, and therefore regarded him as divine.
translations.idiomatic: The scholar had already departed. Gaozu feared his words would leak out and sent men to pursue and kill him, but they could not discover where he had gone, and Gaozu therefore took him for a supernatural being.

sentences.zh: 乃採其語，名之曰世民。

translations.literal: Thereupon he took words from his saying and named him Shimin.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu then took words from the prophecy and named him Shimin.

sentences.zh: 大業中，突厥圍煬帝鴈門，煬帝從圍中以木繫詔書，投汾水而下，募兵赴援。

translations.literal: During Daye, the Turks besieged Emperor Yang at Yanmen; Emperor Yang, from within the siege, tied an edict to wood and cast it down the Fen River to raise troops for relief.
translations.idiomatic: During the Daye reign, the Turks besieged Emperor Yang at Yanmen. From within the encirclement, Emperor Yang tied an edict to a piece of wood and cast it into the Fen River downstream to summon troops for relief.

sentences.zh: 太宗時年十六，往應募，隸將軍雲定興，謂定興曰「虜敢圍吾天子者，以為無援故也。

translations.literal: Taizong was then sixteen; he went to answer the call, was attached to General Yun Dingxing, and said to Dingxing, "The barbarians dare besiege our Son of Heaven because they believe there is no relief."
translations.idiomatic: Taizong was then sixteen years old. He answered the call to arms and was placed under General Yun Dingxing. He told Dingxing, "The barbarians dare besiege our emperor only because they believe no relief is coming."

sentences.zh: 今宜先後吾軍為數十里，使其晝見旌旗，夜聞鉦鼓，以為大至，則可不擊而走之。

translations.literal: Now we should advance and follow our army at intervals of several tens of li, so that by day they see banners and by night hear bells and drums, believing a great force has arrived; then we can drive them off without fighting.
translations.idiomatic: We should now advance and follow our army at intervals of several tens of li, so that by day they see banners and by night hear bells and drums and believe a great army has arrived. Then we can drive them off without giving battle.

sentences.zh: 不然，知我虛實，則勝敗未可知也。

translations.literal: Otherwise, if they know our true strength, then victory and defeat cannot be foretold.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, once they learn our true strength, the outcome cannot be predicted.

sentences.zh: 」定興從之。

translations.literal: Dingxing followed his advice.
translations.idiomatic: Dingxing followed his advice.

sentences.zh: 軍至崞縣，突厥候騎見其軍來不絕，果馳告始畢可汗曰：「救兵大至矣！

translations.literal: When the army reached Guo County, Turk scout cavalry saw its columns coming without cease and indeed galloped to report to Khan Shibi, "Relief troops have arrived in great numbers!"
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Guo County, Turk scout cavalry saw its columns arriving without cease and galloped to report to Khan Shibi, "Relief troops have arrived in great numbers!"

sentences.zh: 」遂引去。

translations.literal: Thereupon they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks thereupon withdrew.

sentences.zh: 高祖擊歷山飛，陷其圍中，太宗馳輕騎取之而出，遂奮擊，大破之。

translations.literal: Gaozu attacked Li Shanfei and fell into his encirclement; Taizong galloped with light cavalry, took him, and brought him out, then pressed the attack and routed him utterly.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu attacked Li Shanfei and was trapped in his encirclement. Taizong galloped in with light cavalry, rescued him, and brought him out, then pressed the attack and routed the enemy completely.

sentences.zh: 太宗為人聦明英武，有大志，而能屈節下士。

translations.literal: Taizong as a man was intelligent, heroic, and martial, with great ambition, yet able to humble himself and honor men of talent.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong was intelligent, heroic, and martial, with great ambition, yet he could humble himself and honor men of talent.

sentences.zh: 時天下已亂，盜賊起，知隋必亡，乃推財養士，結納豪傑。

translations.literal: At that time the realm was already in turmoil and bandits had risen; knowing the Sui would surely perish, he distributed wealth to nurture scholars and won over bold heroes.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the realm was already in turmoil and bandits had risen everywhere. Knowing the Sui dynasty would surely fall, he distributed his wealth to nurture men of talent and won over bold heroes.

sentences.zh: 長孫順德、劉弘基等，皆因事亡命，匿之。

translations.literal: Changsun Shunde, Liu Hongji, and others all fled for their lives on account of affairs, and he hid them.
translations.idiomatic: Changsun Shunde, Liu Hongji, and others had all fled for their lives after running afoul of the law, and he sheltered them.

sentences.zh: 又與晉陽令劉文靜尤善，文靜坐李密事繫獄，太宗夜就獄中見之，與圖大事。

translations.literal: He was also especially close with Jinyang Magistrate Liu Wenjing; Wenjing was imprisoned on account of the Li Mi affair, and Taizong visited him in prison by night and plotted great affairs with him.
translations.idiomatic: He was also especially close with Liu Wenjing, magistrate of Jinyang. Wenjing was imprisoned on account of the Li Mi affair, and Taizong visited him in prison by night to plot their great undertaking.

sentences.zh: 時百姓避賊多入城，城中幾萬人，文靜為令久，知其豪傑，因共部署。

translations.literal: At that time the common people, fleeing bandits, mostly entered the city; within the city there were nearly ten thousand men. Wenjing had long served as magistrate and knew its bold heroes, and so together they deployed them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time common people fleeing bandits had poured into the city until it held nearly ten thousand men. Wenjing had long served as magistrate and knew the city's bold spirits, and together they deployed them.

sentences.zh: 計已定，乃因裴寂告高祖。

translations.literal: Once the plan was settled, he then informed Gaozu through Pei Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Once the plan was settled, he informed Gaozu through Pei Ji.

sentences.zh: 高祖初不許，已而許之。

translations.literal: Gaozu at first did not consent; afterward he consented.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu at first refused, but later agreed.

sentences.zh: 高祖已起兵，建大將軍府。

translations.literal: Gaozu had already raised troops and established the Great General's Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu had already raised troops and established the Great General's Headquarters.

sentences.zh: 太宗率兵徇西河，斬其郡丞高德儒。

translations.literal: Taizong led troops to campaign against Xihe and beheaded its Assistant Administrator Gao Deru.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong led troops against Xihe and beheaded its assistant administrator, Gao Deru.

sentences.zh: 拜右領軍大都督，封燉煌郡公。

translations.literal: He was appointed Right Commander-in-Chief of the Army and enfeoffed as Duke of Dunhuang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Right Commander-in-Chief of the Army and enfeoffed as Duke of Dunhuang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 唐兵西，將至霍邑，會天久雨，糧且盡，高祖謀欲還兵太原。

translations.literal: Tang troops marched west and were about to reach Huoyi when, as heaven sent long rains, provisions were nearly exhausted; Gaozu planned to return the army to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Tang troops marched west and were about to reach Huoyi when prolonged rains set in and provisions ran low. Gaozu planned to withdraw the army to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 太宗諫曰：「義師為天下起也，宜直入咸陽，號令天下。

translations.literal: Taizong remonstrated, saying, "The righteous army rose for the realm; we should march straight into Xianyang and command the realm."
translations.idiomatic: Taizong remonstrated, saying, "This righteous army rose on behalf of the realm. We should march straight into Xianyang and command the empire."

sentences.zh: 今還守一城，是為賊爾。

translations.literal: Now to return and hold a single city is to become bandits.
translations.idiomatic: If we turn back now to hold a single city, we will become nothing but bandits ourselves.

sentences.zh: 」高祖不納。

translations.literal: Gaozu did not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu would not listen.

sentences.zh: 太宗哭于軍門，高祖驚，召問之，對曰：「還則衆散於前，而敵乗於後，死亡須臾，所以悲爾。

translations.literal: Taizong wept at the army gate; Gaozu was startled and summoned him to ask why. He replied, "If we return, the host will scatter before us while the enemy presses from behind; death will come in an instant—that is why I grieve."
translations.idiomatic: Taizong wept at the army gate. Startled, Gaozu summoned him and asked why. He replied, "If we withdraw, our men will scatter ahead of us while the enemy presses from behind. Death will come in an instant—that is why I weep."

sentences.zh: 」高祖寤，曰：「起事者汝也，成敗惟汝。

translations.literal: Gaozu awoke and said, "You are the one who raised this affair; success or failure rests with you alone."
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu came to his senses and said, "You are the one who set this in motion. Success or failure rests with you alone."

sentences.zh: 」時左軍已先返，即與隴西公建成分追之。

translations.literal: At that time the left wing had already returned first; he immediately joined Duke of Longxi Jiancheng in pursuing them.
translations.idiomatic: By then the left wing had already begun to withdraw, and he immediately joined Jiancheng, Duke of Longxi, in pursuing them.

sentences.zh: 夜半，太宗失道入山谷，棄其馬，步而及其兵，與俱還。

translations.literal: At midnight Taizong lost the road and entered a mountain valley; he abandoned his horse, went on foot to overtake his troops, and returned with them together.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight Taizong lost the road and entered a mountain valley. He abandoned his horse, went on foot to overtake his troops, and returned with them.

sentences.zh: 高祖乃將而前，遲明至霍邑。

translations.literal: Gaozu then led the army forward and, as dawn drew near, reached Huoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu then led the army forward and reached Huoyi just before dawn.

sentences.zh: 宋老生不出，太宗從數騎傅其城，舉鞭指麾，若將圍之者。

translations.literal: Song Laosheng did not come out; Taizong, with several horsemen, rode close to his wall, raised his whip, and directed as if about to invest it.
translations.idiomatic: Song Laosheng would not come out. Taizong rode up to the city wall with a few horsemen, raised his whip, and directed his men as though preparing to invest the city.

sentences.zh: 老生怒，出，背城陣。

translations.literal: Laosheng grew angry, came out, and arrayed his forces with the city at his back.
translations.idiomatic: Laosheng, enraged, came out and drew up his forces with the city at his back.

sentences.zh: 高祖率建成居其東，太宗及柴紹居其南。

translations.literal: Gaozu led Jiancheng to hold the east; Taizong and Chai Shao held the south.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu led Jiancheng to hold the east, while Taizong and Chai Shao held the south.

sentences.zh: 老生兵薄東陣，建成墜馬，老生乗之，高祖軍卻。

translations.literal: Laosheng's troops pressed the eastern formation; Jiancheng fell from his horse, Laosheng seized the moment, and Gaozu's army fell back.
translations.idiomatic: Laosheng's troops pressed the eastern formation. Jiancheng fell from his horse, Laosheng seized the moment, and Gaozu's army fell back.

sentences.zh: 太宗自南原馳下阪，分兵斷其軍為二，而出其陣後，老生兵敗走，遂斬之。

translations.literal: Taizong galloped down the slope from the southern heights, divided his troops to cut Laosheng's army in two, and emerged behind his formation; Laosheng's troops were defeated and fled, and he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong galloped down the slope from the southern heights, divided his troops to cut Laosheng's army in two, and emerged behind the enemy formation. Laosheng's troops were defeated and fled, and he was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 進次涇陽，擊胡賊劉鷂子，破之。

translations.literal: Advancing, he halted at Jingyang, attacked the barbarian bandit Liu Yaozi, and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing, he halted at Jingyang, attacked the barbarian bandit Liu Yaozi, and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 唐兵攻長安，太宗屯金城坊，攻其西北，遂克之。

translations.literal: Tang troops attacked Chang'an; Taizong encamped at Jincheng Ward, assaulted the northwest, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Tang troops attacked Chang'an. Taizong encamped at Jincheng Ward, assaulted the northwestern sector, and took it.

sentences.zh: 義寧元年，為光祿大夫、唐國內史，徙封秦國公，食邑萬戶。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yining, he was made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Interior Secretary of the State of Tang, transferred in enfeoffment to Duke of the State of Qin, with a fief of ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yining, he was appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Interior Secretary of the State of Tang, transferred in rank to Duke of the State of Qin, with a fief of ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 薛舉攻扶風，太宗擊敗之，斬首萬餘級，遂略地至隴右。

translations.literal: Xue Ju attacked Fufeng; Taizong defeated him, beheaded more than ten thousand, and then carried the campaign through to Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Ju attacked Fufeng. Taizong defeated him, took more than ten thousand heads, and then carried the campaign through to Longyou.

sentences.zh: 二年，為右元帥，徙封趙國公，率兵十萬攻東都，不克而還，設三伏于三王陵，敗隋將段達兵萬人。

translations.literal: In the second year, he was made Right Grand Marshal, transferred in enfeoffment to Duke of the State of Zhao, led one hundred thousand troops to attack the Eastern Capital, failed to take it and returned, set three ambushes at the Three Kings' Tombs, and defeated ten thousand troops under the Sui general Duan Da.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was appointed Right Grand Marshal and transferred in rank to Duke of the State of Zhao. He led one hundred thousand troops to attack the Eastern Capital, failed to take it, and withdrew. At the Three Kings' Tombs he set three ambushes and defeated ten thousand troops under the Sui general Duan Da.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，鎮長春宮，進拜左武候大將軍、涼州總管。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, he garrisoned Changchun Palace and was promoted to General of the Left Martial Guard and Area Commander of Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year he garrisoned Changchun Palace and was promoted to General of the Left Martial Guard and Area Commander of Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 是時，劉武周據并州，宋金剛陷澮州，王行本據蒲州，而夏縣人呂崇茂殺縣令以應武周。

translations.literal: At this time Liu Wuzhou held Bingzhou, Song Jingang took Fenzhou, Wang Xingben held Puzhou, and Lü Chongmao of Xia County killed the magistrate to join Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Liu Wuzhou held Bingzhou, Song Jingang had taken Fenzhou, Wang Xingben held Puzhou, and Lü Chongmao of Xia County killed the magistrate to join Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 高祖懼，詔諸將棄河東以守關中。

translations.literal: Gaozu was afraid and decreed that the generals abandon Hedong to defend Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu was alarmed and decreed that the generals abandon Hedong to defend Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 太宗以為不可棄，願得兵三萬可以破賊。

translations.literal: Taizong held that it could not be abandoned and wished to receive thirty thousand troops with which he could break the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong argued that Hedong must not be abandoned and asked for thirty thousand troops with which he could break the rebels.

sentences.zh: 高祖於是悉發關中兵益之。

translations.literal: Gaozu thereupon sent out all the troops of Guanzhong to reinforce him.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu thereupon sent out all the troops of Guanzhong to reinforce him.

sentences.zh: 十一月，出龍門關，屯于柏壁。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, he marched out through Longmen Pass and encamped at Baiyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he marched out through Longmen Pass and encamped at Baiyu.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，擊敗宋金剛于柏壁。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, he defeated Song Jingang at Baiyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year he defeated Song Jingang at Baiyu.

sentences.zh: 金剛走介州，太宗追之，一日夜馳二百里，宿于雀鼠谷之西原。

translations.literal: Jingang fled to Jiezhou; Taizong pursued him, riding two hundred li in a day and a night, and encamped on the western heights of Sparrow-Rat Valley.
translations.idiomatic: Jingang fled to Jiezhou, and Taizong pursued him, riding two hundred li in a day and a night before encamping on the western heights of Sparrow-Rat Valley.

sentences.zh: 軍士皆饑，太宗不食者二日，行至浩州乃得食，而金剛將尉遲敬德、尋相等皆來降。

translations.literal: The soldiers were all hungry; Taizong did not eat for two days. When they reached Haozhou they finally obtained food, and Jingang's generals Yuchi Jingde, Xun Xiang, and others all came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers were starving. Taizong went without food for two days. When they reached Haozhou they finally obtained provisions, and Jingang's generals Yuchi Jingde, Xun Xiang, and others all came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 劉武周懼，奔于突厥，其將楊伏念舉并州降。

translations.literal: Liu Wuzhou was afraid and fled to the Turks; his general Yang Funian raised Bingzhou in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wuzhou, in fear, fled to the Turks, and his general Yang Funian surrendered Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 高祖遣蕭瑀即軍中拜太宗益州道行臺尚書令。

translations.literal: Gaozu dispatched Xiao Yu to the army to appoint Taizong Acting Director of the Yizhou Circuit Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu dispatched Xiao Yu to the army to appoint Taizong Acting Director of the Yizhou Circuit Headquarters.

sentences.zh: 七月，討王世充，敗之于北邙。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, he campaigned against Wang Shichong and defeated him at Beimang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he campaigned against Wang Shichong and defeated him at Beimang.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，竇建德率兵十萬以援世充，太宗敗建德于虎牢，執之，世充乃降。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, Dou Jiande led one hundred thousand troops to aid Shichong; Taizong defeated Jiande at Hulao, seized him, and Shichong then surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year, Dou Jiande led one hundred thousand troops to aid Shichong. Taizong defeated Jiande at Hulao, captured him, and Shichong then surrendered.

sentences.zh: 六月，凱旋，太宗被金甲，陳鐵騎一萬、介士三萬，前後鼓吹，獻俘于太廟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, returning in triumph, Taizong wore golden armor, displayed ten thousand iron cavalry and thirty thousand armored soldiers, with drums and pipes before and behind, and presented captives at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, returning in triumph, Taizong wore golden armor and displayed ten thousand iron cavalry and thirty thousand armored soldiers, with drums and pipes before and behind, as he presented captives at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 高祖以謂太宗功高，古官號不足以稱，乃加號天策上將，領司徒、陝東道大行臺尚書令，位在王公上，增邑戶至三萬，賜袞冕、金輅、雙璧、黃金六千斤，前後鼓吹九部之樂，班劍四十人。

translations.literal: Gaozu considered Taizong's merit so high that ancient titles were insufficient to honor it; he therefore added the title Heavenly Strategist General, made him oversee the Minister of Education and Acting Director of the Shaanxi-East Circuit Headquarters, rank above kings and dukes, increase his fief households to thirty thousand, and bestow upon him imperial robes and cap, golden chariot, paired jade disks, six thousand jin of gold, nine sets of drums and pipes before and behind, and forty ceremonial sword-bearers.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu judged Taizong's merit so great that no ancient title could do it justice. He therefore added the title Heavenly Strategist General, made him oversee the Minister of Education and Acting Director of the Shaanxi-East Circuit Headquarters, rank him above kings and dukes, increase his fief to thirty thousand households, and bestow upon him imperial robes and cap, a golden chariot, paired jade disks, six thousand jin of gold, nine sets of drums and pipes before and behind, and forty ceremonial sword-bearers.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，討劉黑闥於洺州，敗之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, he campaigned against Liu Heita at Mingzhou and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year he campaigned against Liu Heita at Mingzhou and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 黑闥旣降，已而復反。

translations.literal: Heita had already surrendered, but afterward rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Heita had already surrendered, but afterward rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 高祖怒，命太子建成取山東男子十五以上悉阬之，驅其小弱婦女以實關中。

translations.literal: Gaozu was angry and ordered Crown Prince Jiancheng to take all men of Shandong fifteen years and above and execute them by burial, driving their weak, women, and children to populate Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu was enraged and ordered Crown Prince Jiancheng to execute by burial all men of Shandong aged fifteen and above, and to drive the weak, women, and children into Guanzhong to repopulate it.

sentences.zh: 太宗切諫，以為不可，遂已。

translations.literal: Taizong urgently remonstrated, holding that it could not be done, and the order was thereupon halted.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong urgently remonstrated against the plan, and the order was thereupon halted.

sentences.zh: 加拜左右十二衛大將軍。

translations.literal: He was further appointed Grand General of the Twelve Guards of the Left and Right.
translations.idiomatic: He was further appointed Grand General of the Twelve Guards of the Left and Right.

sentences.zh: 七年，突厥寇邊，太宗與遇于豳州，從百騎與其可汗語，乃盟而去。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the Turks raided the frontier; Taizong encountered them at Binzhou, went with one hundred horsemen to speak with their khan, then made alliance and departed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the Turks raided the frontier. Taizong encountered them at Binzhou, went forward with one hundred horsemen to speak with their khan, made alliance, and departed.

sentences.zh: 八年，進位中書令。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was promoted to Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was promoted to Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 初，高祖起太原，非其本意，而事出太宗。

translations.literal: At the beginning, when Gaozu raised troops at Taiyuan, it was not his original intent, but the affair arose from Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning, when Gaozu raised troops at Taiyuan, it had not been his original intent; the affair had been set in motion by Taizong.

sentences.zh: 及取天下，破宋金剛、王世充、竇建德等，太宗功益高，而高祖屢許以為太子。

translations.literal: When the realm was taken, and Song Jingang, Wang Shichong, Dou Jiande, and others were defeated, Taizong's merit grew ever higher, and Gaozu repeatedly promised to make him crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: After the realm was won and Song Jingang, Wang Shichong, Dou Jiande, and others were defeated, Taizong's merit grew ever greater, and Gaozu repeatedly promised to make him crown prince.

sentences.zh: 太子建成懼廢，與齊王元吉謀害太宗，未發。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Jiancheng feared being deposed and, with Prince of Qi Yuanji, plotted to harm Taizong, but had not yet acted.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Jiancheng, fearing deposition, plotted with Prince of Qi Yuanji to kill Taizong, but had not yet acted.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，太宗以兵入玄武門，殺太子建成及齊王元吉。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year, Taizong entered Xuanwu Gate with troops and killed Crown Prince Jiancheng and Prince of Qi Yuanji.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the ninth year, Taizong entered Xuanwu Gate with troops and killed Crown Prince Jiancheng and Prince of Qi Yuanji.

sentences.zh: 高祖大驚，乃以太宗為皇太子。

translations.literal: Gaozu was greatly startled and thereupon made Taizong crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu was greatly startled and thereupon made Taizong crown prince.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，即皇帝位于東宮顯德殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the eighth month, he ascended the throne at Xiande Hall in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi in the eighth month he ascended the throne at Xiande Hall in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 遣裴寂告于南郊。

translations.literal: He dispatched Pei Ji to announce it at the Southern Altar.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Pei Ji to announce his accession at the Southern Altar.

sentences.zh: 大赦，武德流人還之。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and exiles of the Wude era were returned.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a general amnesty and allowed exiles of the Wude era to return.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官勳、爵。

translations.literal: Merit ranks and noble titles were bestowed on civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: He bestowed merit ranks and noble titles on civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 免關內及蒲、芮、虞、泰、陝、鼎六州二歲租，給復天下一年。

translations.literal: Two years' land tax was remitted in Guannei and the six prefectures of Pu, Rui, Yu, Tai, Shan, and Ding; corvée and rent were remitted throughout the realm for one year.
translations.idiomatic: He remitted two years' land tax in Guannei and in the six prefectures of Pu, Rui, Yu, Tai, Shan, and Ding, and granted one year's remission of corvée and rent throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 民八十以上賜粟帛，百歲加版授。

translations.literal: Common people eighty years and above were granted grain and silk; at one hundred years an additional official tablet was conferred.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners aged eighty and above were granted grain and silk; those aged one hundred received an additional official tablet of honor.

sentences.zh: 廢潼關以東瀕河諸關。

translations.literal: The passes east of Tong Pass along the river were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished the riverine passes east of Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，放宮女三千餘人。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, more than three thousand palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou he released more than three thousand palace women.

sentences.zh: 丙子，立妃長孫氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Consort Changsun was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi he established Consort Changsun as empress.

sentences.zh: 癸未，突厥寇便橋。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the Turks raided Bian Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei the Turks raided Bian Bridge.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，及突厥頡利盟于便橋。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, he made alliance with the Turk Khan Jieli at Bian Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou he made alliance with the Turk Khan Jieli at Bian Bridge.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，禁私家妖神淫祀、占卜非龜易五兆者。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the ninth month, private worship of demonic spirits and licentious sacrifices was forbidden, as was divination other than by tortoise shell, Changes, or the Five Omens.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi in the ninth month he forbade private worship of demonic spirits and licentious sacrifices, as well as divination by methods other than tortoise shell, the Changes, or the Five Omens.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day bingchen in the tenth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day bingchen in the tenth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，立中山郡王承乾為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Prince of Zhongshan Chengqian was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai he established Chengqian, Prince of Zhongshan, as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，蕭瑀、陳叔達罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Xiao Yu and Chen Shuda were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen Xiao Yu and Chen Shuda were dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，降宗室郡王非有功者爵為縣公。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the eleventh month, imperial clansmen enfeoffed as commandery princes without merit had their titles reduced to county marquises.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin in the eleventh month he reduced to county marquis the titles of imperial clansmen enfeoffed as commandery princes without meritorious service.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the twelfth month, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou in the twelfth month he reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 是歲，進封子長沙郡王恪為漢王，宜陽郡王祐楚王。

translations.literal: That year, his sons were advanced in enfeoffment: Prince of Changsha Ke to Prince of Han, and Prince of Yiyang You to Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: That year he advanced his sons in rank: Ke, Prince of Changsha, became Prince of Han, and You, Prince of Yiyang, became Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 貞觀元年正月乙酉，改元。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou in the first month of the first year of Zhenguan, the reign era was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou in the first month of the first year of Zhenguan, the reign era was changed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，燕郡王李藝反于涇州，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Prince of Yan Commandery Li Yi rebelled at Jingzhou and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou Li Yi, Prince of Yan Commandery, rebelled at Jingzhou and was executed.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，詔民男二十、女十五以上無夫家者，州縣以禮聘娶；

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the second month, an edict declared: "Common men twenty years and above and women fifteen years and above without spouses—let the prefectures and counties betroth and marry them according to ritual."
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the second month an edict declared that common men aged twenty and above and women aged fifteen and above who lacked spouses were to be betrothed and married by their prefectures and counties according to proper ritual.

sentences.zh: 貧不能自行者，鄉里富人及親戚資送之；

translations.literal: Those too poor to manage it themselves—let the wealthy of the village and their kin provide funds and send them off.
translations.idiomatic: Those too poor to manage the arrangements themselves were to be assisted with funds by the wealthy of their villages and by their kin.

sentences.zh: 鰥夫六十、寡婦五十、婦人有子若守節者勿彊。

translations.literal: Widowers sixty years and above, widows fifty years and above, and women with sons or who observe chastity—do not compel them.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers aged sixty and above, widows aged fifty and above, and women who had sons or who observed chastity were not to be compelled.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，皇后親蠶。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the third month, the empress personally tended silkworms.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi in the third month the empress personally tended silkworms.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔：「齊僕射崔季舒、黃門侍郎郭遵、尚書右丞封孝琰以極言蒙難，季舒子剛、遵子雲、孝琰子君遵並及淫刑，宜免內侍，褒敘以官。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, an edict declared: "Qi Left Vice Director Cui Jishu, Yellow Gate Vice Director Guo Zun, and Right Assistant Director of the Ministry of Works Feng Xiaoyan suffered hardship for speaking boldly. Jishu's son Gang, Zun's son Yun, and Xiaoyan's son Jundun all suffered excessive punishment; they should be exempted from palace eunuch service and honored with official appointments."
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu an edict declared that Cui Jishu, Left Vice Director of Qi; Guo Zun, Yellow Gate Vice Director; and Feng Xiaoyan, Right Assistant Director of the Ministry of Works, had suffered for speaking boldly. Their sons Gang, Yun, and Jundun had all been subjected to cruel castration as punishment; they were to be exempted from palace eunuch service and honored with official appointments.

sentences.zh: 」閏月癸丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day guichou in the intercalary month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day guichou in the intercalary month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 四月癸巳，涼州都督、長樂郡王幼良有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the fourth month, Area Commander of Liangzhou and Prince of Changle Commandery Youliang was guilty and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi in the fourth month Youliang, Area Commander of Liangzhou and Prince of Changle Commandery, was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，敕中書令、侍中朝堂受訟辭，有陳事者悉上封。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the fifth month, an order declared that the Director of the Secretariat and the Palace Attendant were to receive litigation petitions in the court hall, and all who had matters to present were to submit sealed memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou in the fifth month he ordered the Director of the Secretariat and the Palace Attendant to receive litigation petitions in the court hall, and directed that all who had matters to present submit sealed memorials.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，封德彝薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the sixth month, Feng Deyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou in the sixth month Feng Deyi died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太子少師蕭瑀為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince Xiao Yu was made Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen Xiao Yu, Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 是夏，山東旱，免今歲租。

translations.literal: That summer, Shandong suffered drought; this year's land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That summer drought struck Shandong, and this year's land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 七月壬子，吏部尚書長孫無忌為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the seventh month, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel Zhangsun Wuji was made Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi in the seventh month Zhangsun Wuji, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 八月河南、隴右邊州霜。

translations.literal: In the eighth month frost struck the border prefectures of Henan and Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month frost struck the border prefectures of Henan and Longyou.

sentences.zh: 宇文士及檢校涼州都督。

translations.literal: Yuwen Shiji was appointed acting Area Commander of Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Shiji was appointed acting Area Commander of Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，貶高士廉為安州大都督。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Gao Shilian was demoted to Grand Area Commander of Anzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu Gao Shilian was demoted to Grand Area Commander of Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day gengxu in the ninth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day gengxu in the ninth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，遣使諸州行損田，賑問下戶。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, envoys were dispatched to the prefectures to assess damaged fields and provide relief to lower households.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou he dispatched envoys to the prefectures to assess damaged fields and provide relief to lower-grade households.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫杜淹檢校吏部尚書，參議朝政。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Du Yan was appointed acting Minister of the Ministry of Personnel and participated in deliberation on court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Du Yan, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed acting Minister of the Ministry of Personnel and joined deliberations on court affairs.

sentences.zh: 宇文士及罷。

translations.literal: Yuwen Shiji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Shiji was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幽州都督王君廓奔于突厥。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Area Commander of Youzhou Wang Junkuo fled to the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei Wang Junkuo, Area Commander of Youzhou, fled to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 十月丁酉，以歲饑減膳。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the tenth month, because of famine that year, imperial meals were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou in the tenth month he reduced imperial meals because of famine that year.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，許子弟年十九以下隨父兄之官所。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the eleventh month, children and younger siblings aged nineteen and below were permitted to accompany fathers and elder brothers to their official posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei in the eleventh month he permitted children and younger siblings aged nineteen and below to accompany fathers and elder brothers to their official posts.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，蕭瑀罷。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the twelfth month, Xiao Yu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu in the twelfth month Xiao Yu was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 戊申，利州都督李孝常、右武衛將軍劉德裕謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Area Commander of Lizhou Li Xiaochang and General of the Right Martial Guards Liu Deyu plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen Li Xiaochang, Area Commander of Lizhou, and Liu Deyu, General of the Right Martial Guards, plotted rebellion and were executed.

sentences.zh: 二年正月辛亥，長孫無忌罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the first month of the second year, Zhangsun Wuji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the first month of the second year Zhangsun Wuji was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書杜如晦檢校侍中，總監東宮兵馬事。

translations.literal: Minister of the Ministry of War Du Ruhui was appointed acting Palace Attendant and oversaw Eastern Palace military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Du Ruhui, Minister of the Ministry of War, was appointed acting Palace Attendant and placed in overall charge of Eastern Palace military affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，吐谷渾寇岷州，都督李道彥敗之。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Tuyuhun raided Minzhou; Area Commander Li Daoyan defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou Tuyuhun raided Minzhou; Li Daoyan, Area Commander, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，徙封恪為蜀王，泰越王，祐燕王。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Ke's fief was transferred and he was enfeoffed as Prince of Shu; Tai as Prince of Yue; You as Prince of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi he transferred Ke's fief and enfeoffed him as Prince of Shu, Tai as Prince of Yue, and You as Prince of Yan.

sentences.zh: 庚午，刑部尚書李靖檢校中書令。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Minister of the Ministry of Punishments Li Jing was appointed acting Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu Li Jing, Minister of the Ministry of Punishments, was appointed acting Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，外官上考者給祿。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the second month, outer officials rated excellent in evaluation were granted salary.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu in the second month outer officials who received top evaluations were granted salary.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day wushen in the third month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day wushen in the third month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命中書門下五品以上及尚書議決死罪。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, he ordered officials of fifth rank and above in the Secretariat and Chancellery, together with the Ministers, to deliberate and decide capital cases.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi he ordered officials of fifth rank and above in the Secretariat and Chancellery, together with the Ministers, to deliberate and decide capital cases.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，李靖為關內道行軍大總管，以備薛延陀。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Li Jing was made Grand Campaign Commander of the Guannei Circuit to guard against Xueyantuo.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu Li Jing was made Grand Campaign Commander of the Guannei Circuit to guard against Xueyantuo.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣使巡關內，出金寶贖饑民鬻子者還之。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, envoys were dispatched to tour Guannei, offering gold and treasure to redeem starving commoners who had sold their children and restore them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi he dispatched envoys to tour Guannei, offering gold and treasure to redeem starving commoners who had sold their children and restore them to their families.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以旱蝗責躬，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, because of drought and locusts he blamed himself and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, because of drought and locusts, he blamed himself and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，雨。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou it rained.

sentences.zh: 四月己卯，瘞隋人暴骸。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the fourth month, unburied corpses of Sui people were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao in the fourth month unburied corpses of Sui subjects were given proper burial.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，朔方人梁洛仁殺梁師都以降。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Liang Luoren of Shuofang killed Liang Shidu and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin Liang Luoren of Shuofang killed Liang Shidu and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，詔出使官稟食其家。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen in the sixth month, an edict declared that envoys on missions were to receive rations for their households.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen in the sixth month an edict declared that envoys on missions were to receive rations for their households.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以子治生，賜是日生子者粟。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, because Prince Zhi was born, grain was granted to all who gave birth on that day.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, because Prince Zhi had been born, he granted grain to all women who gave birth on that day.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，辰州刺史裴虔通以弒隋煬帝削爵，流驩州。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Prefect of Chenzhou Pei Qiantong was stripped of his title for regicide of Sui Emperor Yang and was exiled to Huanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao Pei Qiantong, Prefect of Chenzhou, was stripped of his title for killing Sui Emperor Yang and was exiled to Huanzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月戊申，萊州刺史牛方裕、絳州刺史薛世良、廣州長史唐奉義、虎牙郎將高元禮，以宇文化及之黨，皆除名，徙于邊。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the seventh month, Prefect of Laizhou Niu Fangyu, Prefect of Jiangzhou Xue Shiliang, Chief Administrator of Guangzhou Tang Fengyi, and Tiger-Fang General Gao Yuanli, all as followers of Yuwen Huaji, were struck from the register and exiled to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen in the seventh month Niu Fangyu, Prefect of Laizhou; Xue Shiliang, Prefect of Jiangzhou; Tang Fengyi, Chief Administrator of Guangzhou; and Gao Yuanli, Tiger-Fang General—all followers of Yuwen Huaji—were struck from the register and exiled to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，省冤獄于朝堂。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the eighth month, wrongful imprisonments were reviewed in the court hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu in the eighth month he reviewed wrongful imprisonments in the court hall.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，立二王後廟，置國官。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, temples for the Two Kings were established and state officials were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou he established temples for the Two Kings and appointed state officials to them.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，以有年，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the ninth month, because of a good harvest, a three-day communal feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi in the ninth month, because of a good harvest, he granted a three-day communal feast.

sentences.zh: 十月庚辰，杜淹薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the tenth month, Du Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen in the tenth month Du Yan died.

sentences.zh: 戊子，殺瀛州刺史盧祖尚。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Prefect of Yingzhou Lu Zushang was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi Lu Zushang, Prefect of Yingzhou, was executed.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，有事于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the eleventh month, the suburban sacrifice was performed at the southern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou in the eleventh month he performed the suburban sacrifice at the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，黃門侍郎王珪守侍中。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the twelfth month, Yellow Gate Vice Director Wang Gui served as acting Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen in the twelfth month Wang Gui, Yellow Gate Vice Director, served as acting Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，禁五品以上過市。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, officials of fifth rank and above were forbidden to pass through markets.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi he forbade officials of fifth rank and above to pass through markets.

sentences.zh: 三年正月丙午，以旱避正殿。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the first month of the third year, because of drought he avoided the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu in the first month of the third year, because of drought, he avoided holding court in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，官得上下考者，給祿一年。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, officials who received top-grade evaluations were granted one year's salary.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou officials who received top-grade evaluations were granted one year's salary.

sentences.zh: 戊午，享于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，耕藉田。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai he plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 辛未，裴寂罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Pei Ji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei Pei Ji was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，房玄齡為尚書左僕射，杜如晦為右僕射，尚書右丞魏徵為祕書監，參預朝政。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the second month, Fang Xuanling was made Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Du Ruhui Right Vice Director, and Right Assistant Director of the Ministry of Works Wei Zheng Secretary Director, participating in court deliberations.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin in the second month Fang Xuanling was appointed Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, Du Ruhui Right Vice Director, and Wei Zheng, Right Assistant Director of the Ministry of Works, Secretary Director—all participating in court deliberations.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou in the third month, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou in the third month he reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 四月乙亥，太上皇徙居于大安宮。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the fourth month, the Retired Emperor moved his residence to Dafan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai in the fourth month the Retired Emperor moved his residence to Dafan Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲午，始御太極殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, he first held court in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu he first held court in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賜孝義之家粟五斛，八十以上二斛，九十以上三斛，百歲加絹二匹，婦人正月以來產子者粟一斛。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, households noted for filial piety and righteousness were granted five hu of grain; those aged eighty and above two hu, ninety and above three hu; centenarians received an additional two bolts of silk; women who had given birth since the first month received one hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu he granted five hu of grain to households noted for filial piety and righteousness, two hu to those aged eighty and above and three hu to those aged ninety and above, an additional two bolts of silk to centenarians, and one hu of grain to women who had given birth since the first month.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，周王元方薨。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the fifth month, Prince of Zhou Yuanfang died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou in the fifth month Yuanfang, Prince of Zhou, died.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，以旱慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the sixth month, because of drought prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin in the sixth month, because of drought, he reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大風拔木。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔文武官言事。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, an edict invited civil and military officials to speak on affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu an edict invited civil and military officials to speak on affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day jisi in the eighth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day jisi in the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，李靖為定襄道行軍大總管，以伐突厥。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Li Jing was made Grand Campaign Commander of the Dingxiang Circuit to attack the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai Li Jing was made Grand Campaign Commander of the Dingxiang Circuit to attack the Turks.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，華州刺史柴紹為勝州道行軍總管，以伐突厥。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the ninth month, Prefect of Huazhou Chai Shao was made Campaign Commander of the Shengzhou Circuit to attack the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the ninth month Chai Shao, Prefect of Huazhou, was made Campaign Commander of the Shengzhou Circuit to attack the Turks.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，并州都督李世勣為通漠道行軍總管，華州刺史柴紹為金河道行軍總管，任城郡王道宗為大同道行軍總管，幽州都督衛孝節為恒安道行軍總管，營州都督薛萬淑為暢武道行軍總管，以伐突厥。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the eleventh month, Area Commander of Bingzhou Li Shiji was made Campaign Commander of the Tongmo Circuit, Prefect of Huazhou Chai Shao Campaign Commander of the Jinhe Circuit, Prince of Rencheng Commandery Daozong Campaign Commander of the Datong Circuit, Area Commander of Youzhou Wei Xiaojie Campaign Commander of the Heng'an Circuit, and Area Commander of Yingzhou Xue Wanshu Campaign Commander of the Changwu Circuit, to attack the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen in the eleventh month Li Shiji, Area Commander of Bingzhou, was made Campaign Commander of the Tongmo Circuit; Chai Shao, Prefect of Huazhou, Campaign Commander of the Jinhe Circuit; Daozong, Prince of Rencheng Commandery, Campaign Commander of the Datong Circuit; Wei Xiaojie, Area Commander of Youzhou, Campaign Commander of the Heng'an Circuit; and Xue Wanshu, Area Commander of Yingzhou, Campaign Commander of the Changwu Circuit—all to attack the Turks.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，杜如晦罷。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the twelfth month, Du Ruhui was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei in the twelfth month Du Ruhui was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸丑，為死兵者立浮屠祠。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the intercalary month, Buddhist shrines were erected for soldiers who had died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou in the intercalary month he erected Buddhist shrines for soldiers who had died in battle.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou he reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 是歲，中國人歸自塞外及開四夷為州縣者百二十餘萬人。

translations.literal: That year, Chinese who returned from beyond the frontier and those for whom the four Yi regions were opened as prefectures and counties numbered more than 1,200,000.
translations.idiomatic: That year more than 1,200,000 Chinese returned from beyond the frontier, and peoples of the four quarters were incorporated as prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 四年正月丁卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day dingmao in the first month of the fourth year, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day dingmao in the first month of the fourth year there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，武德殿北院火。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, fire broke out in the north compound of Wude Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi fire broke out in the north compound of Wude Hall.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，幸溫湯。

translations.literal: On the day jihai in the second month, he visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai in the second month he visited the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李靖及突厥戰于陰山，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Li Jing fought the Turks at Yinshan and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen Li Jing fought the Turks at Yinshan and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 丙午，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu he returned from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大赦，賜酺五日。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, a general amnesty was proclaimed and a five-day communal feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin he proclaimed a general amnesty and granted a five-day communal feast.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫溫彥博為中書令，王珪為侍中；

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Wen Yanbo was made Director of the Secretariat, and Wang Gui Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yanbo, Censor-in-Chief, was made Director of the Secretariat, and Wang Gui Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 民部尚書戴冑檢校吏部尚書，參豫朝政；

translations.literal: Minister of the Ministry of Revenue Dai Zhou was appointed acting Minister of the Ministry of Personnel and participated in forecourt deliberations on court affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Dai Zhou, Minister of the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed acting Minister of the Ministry of Personnel and joined forecourt deliberations on court affairs;

sentences.zh: 太常卿蕭瑀為御史大夫，與宰臣參議朝政。

translations.literal: Minister of Ceremonies Xiao Yu was made Censor-in-Chief and, with the chief ministers, participated in deliberation on court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yu, Minister of Ceremonies, was made Censor-in-Chief and, with the chief ministers, joined deliberations on court affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以旱詔公卿言事。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, because of drought an edict invited the dukes and ministers to speak on affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, because of drought, an edict invited the dukes and ministers to speak on affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，李靖俘突厥頡利可汗以獻。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the third month, Li Jing captured the Turk Khan Jieli and presented him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu in the third month Li Jing captured the Turk Khan Jieli and presented him at court.

sentences.zh: 四月戊戌，西北君長請上號為「天可汗」。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the fourth month, chieftains of the northwest requested that he take the title "Heaven Qaghan."
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu in the fourth month chieftains of the northwest requested that he accept the title "Heaven Qaghan."

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，發卒治洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On the day yimao in the sixth month, conscript labor was dispatched to repair Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao in the sixth month he dispatched conscript labor to repair Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 七月甲子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day jiazi in the seventh month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day jiazi in the seventh month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，蕭瑀罷。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Xiao Yu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou Xiao Yu was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太上皇不豫，廢朝。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the Retired Emperor fell ill and court sessions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu the Retired Emperor fell ill and court sessions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，疾愈，賜都督刺史文武官及民年八十以上、孝子表門閭者有差。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, upon recovery from illness, differentiated gifts were granted to area commanders, prefects, civil and military officials, commoners aged eighty and above, and filial sons honored at their gates and lanes.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, upon the Retired Emperor's recovery from illness, differentiated gifts were granted to area commanders, prefects, civil and military officials, commoners aged eighty and above, and filial sons whose virtue had been honored at their gates and lanes.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，李靖為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the eighth month, Li Jing was made Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin in the eighth month Li Jing was appointed Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，瘞長城南隋人暴骨。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu in the ninth month, exposed bones of Sui people south of the Great Wall were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu in the ninth month exposed bones of Sui subjects south of the Great Wall were given proper burial.

sentences.zh: 己卯，如隴州。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, he went to Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao he went to Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，禁芻牧于古明君、賢臣、烈士之墓者。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, grazing and herding at the tombs of ancient enlightened rulers, worthy ministers, and martyrs was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu he forbade grazing and herding at the tombs of ancient enlightened rulers, worthy ministers, and martyrs.

sentences.zh: 十月壬辰，赦岐、隴二州，免今歲租賦，降咸陽、始平、武功死罪以下。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the tenth month, Qi and Long circuits were granted amnesty; this year's taxes were remitted; and in Xianyang, Shiping, and Wugong all sentences below capital punishment were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen in the tenth month he granted amnesty to Qi and Long circuits, remitted this year's taxes, and reduced all sentences below capital punishment in Xianyang, Shiping, and Wugong.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，獵于貴泉谷。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, he hunted at Guiquan Valley.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou he hunted at Guiquan Valley.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，獵于魚龍川，獻獲于大安宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, he hunted at Yulong Stream and presented the catch at Dafan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen he hunted at Yulong Stream and presented the catch at Dafan Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免武功今歲租賦。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, this year's taxes in Wugong were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao this year's taxes in Wugong were remitted.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，右衛大將軍侯君集為兵部尚書，參議朝政。

translations.literal: On the day renxu in the eleventh month, Great General of the Right Guards Hou Junji was made Minister of the Ministry of War and participated in deliberation on court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu in the eleventh month Hou Junji, Great General of the Right Guards, was made Minister of the Ministry of War and joined deliberations on court affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲子，至自隴州。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, he returned from Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi he returned from Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，除鞭背刑。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, the punishment of back-whipping was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin he abolished the punishment of back-whipping.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，獵于鹿苑。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen in the twelfth month, he hunted at the Deer Park.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen in the twelfth month he hunted at the Deer Park.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，至自鹿苑。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, he returned from the Deer Park.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi he returned from the Deer Park.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下斷死罪者二十九人。

translations.literal: That year, throughout the realm only twenty-nine persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: That year only twenty-nine persons throughout the realm were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 八年正月辛丑，張士貴及獠戰，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the first month of the eighth year, Zhang Shigui fought the Liao and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou in the first month of the eighth year Zhang Shigui fought the Liao and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，遣使循省天下。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, envoys were dispatched to inspect the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin he dispatched envoys to inspect the realm.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，皇太子加元服。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the second month, the crown prince received the capping ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi in the second month the crown prince received the capping ceremony.

sentences.zh: 丙午，降死罪以下，賜五品以上子為父後者爵一級，民酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, all sentences below capital punishment were reduced; sons of fifth-rank officials and above who were heirs received one rank of nobility; and the common people were granted a three-day communal feast.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu he reduced all sentences below capital punishment, granted one rank of nobility to sons of fifth-rank officials and above who were designated heirs, and granted the common people a three-day communal feast.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，如九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the third month, he went to Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen in the third month he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day xinwei in the fifth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day xinwei in the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是夏，吐谷渾寇涼州，左驍衛大將軍段志玄為西海道行軍總管，左驍衛將軍樊興為赤水道行軍總管，以伐之。

translations.literal: That summer, Tuyuhun raided Liangzhou. Duan Zhixuan, Grand General of the Left Xiaowei Guard, was made marching commander of the Xihai route, and Fan Xing, General of the Left Xiaowei Guard, was made marching commander of the Chishui route, to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Tuyuhun raided Liangzhou. Duan Zhixuan, Grand General of the Left Xiaowei Guard, was appointed marching commander of the Xihai route, and Fan Xing, General of the Left Xiaowei Guard, was appointed marching commander of the Chishui route, to attack them.

sentences.zh: 七月，隴右山崩。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, mountains in Longyou collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month mountains in Longyou collapsed.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，有星孛于虛、危。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the eighth month, a broom star appeared in Xu and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi in the eighth month a broom star appeared in Xu and Wei.

sentences.zh: 十月，作永安宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Yong'an Palace was constructed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Yong'an Palace was constructed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，李靖罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the eleventh month, Li Jing was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei in the eleventh month Li Jing was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 己丑，吐谷渾寇涼州，執行人鴻臚丞趙德楷。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Tuyuhun raided Liangzhou and seized Zhao Dekai, deputy director of the Chamberlain for Dependencies who was traveling as an envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou Tuyuhun raided Liangzhou and seized Zhao Dekai, deputy director of the Chamberlain for Dependencies who was traveling as an envoy.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，特進李靖為西海道行軍大總管，侯君集為積石道行軍總管，任城郡王道宗為鄯善道行軍總管，膠東郡公道彥為赤水道行軍總管，涼州都督李大亮為且末道行軍總管，利州刺史高甑生為鹽澤道行軍總管，以伐吐谷渾。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the twelfth month, Senior Counselor Li Jing was made grand marching commander of the Xihai route; Hou Junji was made marching commander of the Jishi route; Prince Daozong of Rencheng commandery was made marching commander of the Shanshan route; Prince Daoyan of Jiaodong commandery was made marching commander of the Chishui route; Li Daliang, military governor of Liangzhou, was made marching commander of the Qiemo route; and Gao Zengsheng, prefect of Lizhou, was made marching commander of the Yanze route, to attack Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou in the twelfth month Senior Counselor Li Jing was appointed grand marching commander of the Xihai route; Hou Junji was appointed marching commander of the Jishi route; Prince Daozong of Rencheng commandery was appointed marching commander of the Shanshan route; Prince Daoyan of Jiaodong commandery was appointed marching commander of the Chishui route; Li Daliang, military governor of Liangzhou, was appointed marching commander of the Qiemo route; and Gao Zengsheng, prefect of Lizhou, was appointed marching commander of the Yanze route, to attack Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，從太上皇閱武于城西。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, he accompanied the Retired Emperor to review troops west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao he accompanied the Retired Emperor to review troops west of the city.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，党項羌叛。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, the Tangut Qiang rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year the Tangut Qiang rebelled.

sentences.zh: 二月，長孫無忌罷。

translations.literal: In the second month, Zhangsun Wuji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Zhangsun Wuji was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，洮州羌殺刺史孔長秀，附于吐谷渾。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the third month, the Qiang of Taozhou killed Prefect Kong Changxiu and submitted to Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen in the third month the Qiang of Taozhou killed Prefect Kong Changxiu and submitted to Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu he proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，高甑生及羌人戰，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Gao Zengsheng fought the Qiang and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou Gao Zengsheng fought the Qiang and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 閏四月丙寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day bingyin in the intercalary fourth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day bingyin in the intercalary fourth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 五月，長孫無忌起復。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Zhangsun Wuji resumed office after mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Zhangsun Wuji resumed office after mourning.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太上皇崩，皇太子聽政。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the Retired Emperor died, and the crown prince assumed governance.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi the Retired Emperor died, and the crown prince assumed governance.

sentences.zh: 壬子，李靖及吐谷渾戰，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Li Jing fought Tuyuhun and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi Li Jing fought Tuyuhun and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 七月庚子，鹽澤道行軍副總管劉德敏及羌人戰，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the seventh month, Liu Demin, deputy marching commander of the Yanze route, fought the Qiang and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi in the seventh month Liu Demin, deputy marching commander of the Yanze route, fought the Qiang and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十月庚寅，葬太武皇帝于獻陵。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the tenth month, Emperor Tai Wu was buried at Xianling.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin in the tenth month Emperor Tai Wu was buried at Xianling.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，特進蕭瑀參豫朝政。

translations.literal: On the day renxu in the eleventh month, Senior Counselor Xiao Yu resumed participation in court governance.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu in the eleventh month Senior Counselor Xiao Yu resumed participation in court governance.

sentences.zh: 十年正月甲午，復聽政。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the first month of the tenth year, he resumed personal governance.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu in the first month of the tenth year he resumed personal governance.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，徙封元景為荊王，元昌漢王，元禮徐王，元嘉韓王，元則彭王，元懿鄭王，元軌霍王，元鳳虢王，元慶道王，靈夔燕王，恪吳王，泰魏王，祐齊王，愔蜀王，惲蔣王，貞越王，慎紀王。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Yuan Jing was transferred to Prince of Jing; Yuan Chang to Prince of Han; Yuan Li to Prince of Xu; Yuan Jia to Prince of Han; Yuan Ze to Prince of Peng; Yuan Yi to Prince of Zheng; Yuan Gui to Prince of Huo; Yuan Feng to Prince of Guo; Yuan Qing to Prince of Dao; Ling Kui to Prince of Yan; Ke to Prince of Wu; Tai to Prince of Wei; You to Prince of Qi; Yin to Prince of Shu; Yun to Prince of Jiang; Zhen to Prince of Yue; and Shen to Prince of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou Yuan Jing was transferred to Prince of Jing; Yuan Chang to Prince of Han; Yuan Li to Prince of Xu; Yuan Jia to Prince of Han; Yuan Ze to Prince of Peng; Yuan Yi to Prince of Zheng; Yuan Gui to Prince of Huo; Yuan Feng to Prince of Guo; Yuan Qing to Prince of Dao; Ling Kui to Prince of Yan; Ke to Prince of Wu; Tai to Prince of Wei; You to Prince of Qi; Yin to Prince of Shu; Yun to Prince of Jiang; Zhen to Prince of Yue; and Shen to Prince of Ji.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，出諸王為都督。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the third month, the princes were dispatched as military governors.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou in the third month the princes were dispatched as military governors.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，溫彥博為尚書右僕射，太常卿楊師道為侍中。

translations.literal: On the day renshen in the sixth month, Wen Yanbo was made Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, and Yang Shidao, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen in the sixth month Wen Yanbo was appointed Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, and Yang Shidao, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was appointed Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 魏徵罷為特進，知門下省事，參議朝章國典。

translations.literal: Wei Zheng was dismissed and made Senior Counselor, charged with affairs of the Chancellery, and participated in deliberating court regulations and state institutions.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zheng was dismissed and made Senior Counselor, charged with affairs of the Chancellery, and participated in deliberating court regulations and state institutions.

sentences.zh: 己卯，皇后崩。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the empress died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao the empress died.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，葬文德皇后于昭陵。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the eleventh month, Empress Wendé was buried at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin in the eleventh month Empress Wendé was buried at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 十二月，蕭瑀罷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Xiao Yu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xiao Yu was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen he reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月丁亥，徙封元裕為鄧王，元名舒王。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the first month of the eleventh year, Yuan Yu was transferred to Prince of Deng, and Yuan Ming to Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai in the first month of the eleventh year Yuan Yu was transferred to Prince of Deng, and Yuan Ming to Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 庚子，作飛仙宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Feixian Palace was constructed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi Feixian Palace was constructed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免雍州今歲租賦。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, rent and tribute for Yongzhou were remitted for the year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao he remitted rent and tribute for Yongzhou for the year.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，營九嵕山為陵，賜功臣、密戚陪塋地及祕器。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the second month, Jiushan was prepared as a tomb mound; burial plots and funerary objects were granted to meritorious officials and close imperial kin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the second month Jiushan was prepared as a tomb mound, and burial plots and funerary objects were granted to meritorious officials and close imperial kin.

sentences.zh: 甲子，如洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, he went to Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi he went to Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，給民百歲以上侍五人。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, households with persons aged one hundred or more were granted five attendants each.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou households with persons aged one hundred or more were granted five attendants each.

sentences.zh: 壬午，獵于鹿臺嶺。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, he hunted at Lütaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu he hunted at Lütaoling.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day bingxu in the third month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day bingxu in the third month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，降洛州囚見徒，免一歲租、調。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, convicts in Luozhou were released, and one year's rent and corvée were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao he released convicts in Luozhou and remitted one year's rent and corvée.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，獵于廣成澤。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, he hunted at Guangcheng Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai he hunted at Guangcheng Marsh.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，如洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, he went to Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou he went to Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，溫彥博薨。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the sixth month, Wen Yanbo died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin in the sixth month Wen Yanbo died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，幸明德宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, he visited Mingde Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi he visited Mingde Palace.

sentences.zh: 己未，以諸王為世封刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the princes were appointed as hereditary prefectural governors.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei the princes were appointed as hereditary prefectural governors.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以功臣為世封刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, meritorious officials were appointed as hereditary prefectural governors.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen meritorious officials were appointed as hereditary prefectural governors.

sentences.zh: 己巳，徙封元祥為江王。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Yuan Xiang was transferred to Prince of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi Yuan Xiang was transferred to Prince of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，大雨，水，穀、洛溢。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the seventh month, heavy rain caused flooding, and the Gu and Luo rivers overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei in the seventh month heavy rain caused flooding, and the Gu and Luo rivers overflowed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔百官言事。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, an edict summoned officials to submit memorials on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei he issued an edict summoning officials to submit memorials on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，廢明德宮之玄圃院，賜遭水家。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the Xuanpu Garden of Mingde Palace was abolished and granted to flood-affected households.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin he abolished the Xuanpu Garden of Mingde Palace and granted it to flood-affected households.

sentences.zh: 丙午，給亳州老子廟、兗州孔子廟戶各二十以奉享，復涼武昭王近墓戶二十以守衛。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, twenty households were assigned to each of the temples to Laozi in Bozhou and Confucius in Yanzhou for maintenance of offerings, and twenty households were restored to guard the tomb of Prince Zhaowu of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu he assigned twenty households each to the temples to Laozi in Bozhou and Confucius in Yanzhou for maintenance of offerings, and restored twenty households to guard the tomb of Prince Zhaowu of Liang.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，河溢，壞陝州河北縣，毀河陽中潬，幸白司馬阪觀之，賜瀕河遭水家粟帛。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the ninth month, the Yellow River overflowed, destroying Hebei county in Shaanzhou and breaching the central sandbar at Heyang; he went to Baisima Slope to view it and granted grain and cloth to flood-affected households along the river.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai in the ninth month the Yellow River overflowed, destroying Hebei county in Shaanzhou and breaching the central sandbar at Heyang; he went to Baisima Slope to view the damage and granted grain and cloth to flood-affected households along the river.

sentences.zh: 十月癸丑，賜先朝謀臣武將及親戚亡者塋陪獻陵。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the tenth month, burial plots at Xianling were granted to deceased military strategists and generals of the previous reign and deceased imperial kin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou in the tenth month he granted burial plots at Xianling to deceased military strategists and generals of the previous reign and deceased imperial kin.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，如懷州。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao in the eleventh month, he went to Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao in the eleventh month he went to Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，獵于濟源麥山。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, he hunted at Mai Mountain in Jiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei he hunted at Mai Mountain in Jiyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，如洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, he went to Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu he went to Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月乙未，叢州地震。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the first month of the twelfth year, Congzhou was struck by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei in the first month of the twelfth year Congzhou was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，松州地震。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Songzhou was struck by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao Songzhou was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，如河北縣，觀厎柱。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the second month, he went to Hebei county to inspect the river-control pillars.
