translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai in the second month he went to Hebei county to inspect the river-control pillars.

sentences.zh: 甲子，巫州獠反，夔州都督齊善行敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the Liao of Wuzhou rebelled; Qi Shanxing, military governor of Kuizhou, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi the Liao of Wuzhou rebelled, and Qi Shanxing, military governor of Kuizhou, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，如陝州。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, he went to Shaanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou he went to Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，觀鹽池。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, he inspected the salt ponds.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao he inspected the salt ponds.

sentences.zh: 庚午，如蒲州。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, he went to Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu he went to Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，如長春宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, he went to Changchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu he went to Changchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 免朝邑今歲租賦，降囚罪。

translations.literal: Rent and tribute for Chaoyi were remitted for the year, and sentences of prisoners were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: He remitted rent and tribute for Chaoyi for the year and reduced sentences of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，獵于河濱。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, he hunted along the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai he hunted along the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day gengchen in the intercalary month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day gengchen in the intercalary month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，至自長春宮。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, he returned from Changchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu he returned from Changchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 七月癸酉，吏部尚書高士廉為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the seventh month, Gao Shilian, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou in the seventh month Gao Shilian, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，吐蕃寇松州，侯君集為當彌道行軍大總管，率三總管兵以伐之。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the eighth month, Tufan raided Songzhou; Hou Junji was made grand marching commander of the Dangmi route and led the forces of three commanders to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin in the eighth month Tufan raided Songzhou; Hou Junji was appointed grand marching commander of the Dangmi route and led the forces of three commanders to attack them.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，闊水道行軍總管牛進達及吐蕃戰于松州，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the ninth month, Niu Jinda, marching commander of the Kuanshui route, fought Tufan at Songzhou and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the ninth month Niu Jinda, marching commander of the Kuanshui route, fought Tufan at Songzhou and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十月己卯，獵于始平，賜高年粟帛。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the tenth month, he hunted at Shiping and granted grain and cloth to the elderly.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao in the tenth month he hunted at Shiping and granted grain and cloth to the elderly.

sentences.zh: 乙未，至自始平。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, he returned from Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei he returned from Shiping.

sentences.zh: 鈞州山獠反，桂州都督張寶德敗之。

translations.literal: The mountain Liao of Junzhou rebelled; Zhang Baode, military governor of Guizhou, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The mountain Liao of Junzhou rebelled, and Zhang Baode, military governor of Guizhou, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，明州山獠反，交州都督李道彥敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jisi in the eleventh month, the mountain Liao of Mingzhou rebelled; Li Daoyan, military governor of Jiaozhou, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi in the eleventh month the mountain Liao of Mingzhou rebelled, and Li Daoyan, military governor of Jiaozhou, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，壁州山獠反，右武候將軍上官懷仁討之。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the twelfth month, the mountain Liao of Bizhou rebelled; Shangguan Huairen, General of the Right Martial Guard, was dispatched to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi in the twelfth month the mountain Liao of Bizhou rebelled, and Shangguan Huairen, General of the Right Martial Guard, was dispatched to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 是歲，滁、豪二州野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: That year, wild silkworms in Chuzhou and Haozhou formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: That year wild silkworms in Chuzhou and Haozhou formed cocoons.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月乙巳，拜獻陵，赦三原及行從，免縣人今歲租賦，賜宿衛陵邑郎將、三原令爵一級。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the first month of the thirteenth year, he paid respects at Xianling; Sanyuan and those who accompanied him were granted amnesty; rent and tribute for the county's people were remitted for the year; and the commandant of the guard for the tomb district and the magistrate of Sanyuan were each granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi in the first month of the thirteenth year he paid respects at Xianling, granted amnesty to Sanyuan and those who accompanied him, remitted rent and tribute for the county's people for the year, and granted one rank of nobility each to the commandant of the guard for the tomb district and the magistrate of Sanyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，至自獻陵。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, he returned from Xianling.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei he returned from Xianling.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，停世封刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the second month, hereditary prefectural governorships were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi in the second month he abolished hereditary prefectural governorships.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，有星孛于畢、昴。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the third month, a broom star appeared in Bi and Mao.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou in the third month a broom star appeared in Bi and Mao.

sentences.zh: 四月戊寅，如九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the fourth month, he went to Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin in the fourth month he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲申，中郎將阿史那結社率反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Ashina Jieshelü, Lieutenant General, rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen Ashina Jieshelü, Lieutenant General, rebelled and was executed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，雲陽石然。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, stones burned in Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin stones burned in Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，以旱避正殿，詔五品以上言事，減膳，罷役，理囚，賑乏，乃雨。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the fifth month, because of drought he moved from the main hall; he issued an edict summoning officials of fifth rank and above to submit memorials, reduced his meals, suspended corvée labor, reviewed prisoners, and provided relief to the needy; then rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin in the fifth month, because of drought he moved from the main hall, issued an edict summoning officials of fifth rank and above to submit memorials, reduced his meals, suspended corvée labor, reviewed prisoners, and provided relief to the needy; then rain fell.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，封弟元嬰為滕王。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the sixth month, his younger brother Yuan Ying was enfeoffed as Prince of Teng.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen in the sixth month he enfeoffed his younger brother Yuan Ying as Prince of Teng.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day xinwei in the eighth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day xinwei in the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十月甲申，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen in the tenth month, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen in the tenth month he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，楊師道為中書令。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the eleventh month, Yang Shidao was made Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the eleventh month Yang Shidao was appointed Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，尚書左丞劉洎為黃門侍郎，參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Liu Ji, Left Assistant Director of the Ministry of Works, was made Yellow Gate Vice Director and participated in governance.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen Liu Ji, Left Assistant Director of the Ministry of Works, was appointed Yellow Gate Vice Director and participated in governance.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，侯君集為交河道行軍大總管，以伐高昌。

translations.literal: On the day renshen in the twelfth month, Hou Junji was made grand marching commander of the Jiaohe route to attack Gaochang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen in the twelfth month Hou Junji was appointed grand marching commander of the Jiaohe route to attack Gaochang.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，封子福為趙王。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, his son Fu was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai he enfeoffed his son Fu as Prince of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，獵于咸陽。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, he hunted at Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen he hunted at Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，至自咸陽。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, he returned from Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi he returned from Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，滁州野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: That year, wild silkworms in Chuzhou formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: That year wild silkworms in Chuzhou formed cocoons.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月庚子，有司讀時令。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the first month of the fourteenth year, the relevant offices read the seasonal ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi in the first month of the fourteenth year the relevant offices read the seasonal ordinances.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸魏王泰第，赦雍州長安縣，免延康里今歲租賦。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, he visited the residence of Prince of Wei Tai; Chang'an county in Yongzhou was granted amnesty, and rent and tribute for Yankang ward were remitted for the year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin he visited the residence of Prince of Wei Tai, granted amnesty to Chang'an county in Yongzhou, and remitted rent and tribute for Yankang ward for the year.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，觀釋奠于國學，赦大理、萬年縣，賜學官高第生帛。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou in the second month, he observed the Confucian sacrifice at the National Academy; Dali and Wannian counties were granted amnesty, and silk was granted to top-ranking students and academy officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou in the second month he observed the Confucian sacrifice at the National Academy, granted amnesty to Dali and Wannian counties, and granted silk to top-ranking students and academy officials.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸溫湯。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, he visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu he visited the hot springs.

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao he returned from the hot springs.

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, descendants were sought of Huang Kan and Chu Zhongdu of Liang; Xiong Ansheng and Shen Chong of Zhou; Shen Wena, Zhou Hongzheng, and Zhang Ji of Chen; and He Tuo, Liu Chuo, and Liu Xuan of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei he sought descendants of Huang Kan and Chu Zhongdu of Liang; Xiong Ansheng and Shen Chong of Zhou; Shen Wena, Zhou Hongzheng, and Zhang Ji of Chen; and He Tuo, Liu Chuo, and Liu Xuan of Sui.

sentences.zh: 三月，羅、竇二州獠反，廣州總管党仁弘敗之。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Liao of Luo and Dou prefectures rebelled; Dang Renhong, area commander of Guangzhou, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Liao of Luo and Dou prefectures rebelled, and Dang Renhong, area commander of Guangzhou, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，徙封靈夔為魯王。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the fifth month, Ling Kui was transferred to Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin in the fifth month Ling Kui was transferred to Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 六月，滁州野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, wild silkworms in Chuzhou formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month wild silkworms in Chuzhou formed cocoons.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，作襄城宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu in the eighth month, Xiangcheng Palace was constructed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu in the eighth month Xiangcheng Palace was constructed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，侯君集克高昌。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Hou Junji captured Gaochang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou Hou Junji captured Gaochang.

sentences.zh: 閏十月乙未，如同州。

translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei in the intercalary tenth month he went to Tongzhou.

translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen he hunted at Yaoshan.

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, he returned from Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu he returned from Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，有事于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the eleventh month, he performed the suburban sacrifice at the southern altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi in the eleventh month he performed the suburban sacrifice at the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，侯君集俘高昌王以獻，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the twelfth month, Hou Junji captured the King of Gaochang and presented him; a three-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou in the twelfth month Hou Junji captured the King of Gaochang and presented him, and a three-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，獵于樊川。

translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao he hunted at Fanchuan.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi he returned from Fanchuan.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月辛巳，如洛陽宮，次溫湯。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the first month of the fifteenth year, he went to Luoyang Palace, stopping at the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi in the first month of the fifteenth year he went to Luoyang Palace, stopping at the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 衛士崔卿、刁文懿謀反，伏誅。

translations.idiomatic: The guard officers Cui Qing and Diao Wenyi plotted rebellion and were executed.

translations.literal: On the day wuchen in the third month, he went to Xiangcheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen in the third month he went to Xiangcheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 四月辛卯，詔以來歲二月有事于泰山。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao in the fourth month, an edict ordered the feng sacrifice at Mount Tai in the second month of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao in the fourth month he issued an edict ordering the feng sacrifice at Mount Tai in the second month of the coming year.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei he remitted rent for Luozhou for the year, granted an additional year of tax exemption to relocated households previously exempted, granted gifts to people aged eighty or more, and granted two hu of grain to the orphaned, widowed, and sick who could not support themselves.

sentences.zh: 慮囚。

translations.literal: Prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: He reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，有星孛于太微。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou in the sixth month, a broom star appeared in Taowei.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou in the sixth month a broom star appeared in Taowei.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，停封泰山，避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the Mount Tai feng was suspended; he moved from the main hall and reduced his meals.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen he suspended the Mount Tai feng, moved from the main hall, and reduced his meals.

sentences.zh: 七月丙寅，宥周、隋名臣及忠烈子孫貞觀以後流配者。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin in the seventh month, distinguished ministers of Zhou and Sui and descendants of the faithful and martyrs who had been exiled since the Zhenguan era were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin in the seventh month he pardoned distinguished ministers of Zhou and Sui and descendants of the faithful and martyrs who had been exiled since the Zhenguan era.

translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao in the tenth month he hunted at Yique.

translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen he went to Luoyang Palace.

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the eleventh month, Xue Yantuo raided the frontier; Li Shiji, Minister of the Ministry of War, was made marching commander of the Shuozhou route; Li Daliang, Grand General of the Right Guard, was made marching commander of the Lingzhou route; and Li Xiyu, military governor of Liangzhou, was made marching commander of the Liangzhou route, to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou in the eleventh month Xue Yantuo raided the frontier; Li Shiji, Minister of the Ministry of War, was appointed marching commander of the Shuozhou route; Li Daliang, Grand General of the Right Guard, was appointed marching commander of the Lingzhou route; and Li Xiyu, military governor of Liangzhou, was appointed marching commander of the Liangzhou route, to attack them.

translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi in the twelfth month he returned from Luoyang Palace.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi he posthumously promoted deceased officers and soldiers killed in battle three ranks.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou in the first month of the sixteenth year he dispatched envoys to pacify Xizhou.

translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen he recruited men to garrison Xizhou; those previously guilty of exile who had fled and concealed themselves were permitted to surrender and enlist.

translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei he transferred condemned prisoners under death sentence throughout the realm to populate Xizhou.

translations.idiomatic: Cen Wenben, Drafting Secretary of the Secretariat, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, charged exclusively with confidential affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，太白晝見。

translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu in the sixth month Venus was visible in daytime.

translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu he hunted on the southern slopes of Mount Qi.

translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi he granted felt, quilts, grain, and cloth to the elderly, orphans, and sick in the six counties he passed through, then visited Qingshan Palace.

translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu he returned from Qingshan Palace.

translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the twelfth month he visited the hot springs.

translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen he hunted at Mount Li.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi he returned from the hot springs.

translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai in the second month he reviewed prisoners.

translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen he had portraits of meritorious officials painted at the Lingyan Pavilion.

translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi in the third month he prohibited burials in violation of regulations.

translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, because of drought he dispatched envoys to review prisoners and decide cases.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou Prince of Qi You was executed, and tax exemption was granted to Qizhou for one year.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou in the fourth month the crown prince was deposed as a commoner; Prince of Han Yuan Chang, Hou Junji, and others were executed.

translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou Gao Shilian was appointed Associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of Third Rank and Vice Director of the Secretariat.

translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the intercalary month he issued an edict ordering the crown prince to command the left and right garrison troops.

translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi Tai was transferred to Prince of Shunyang commandery.

translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou in the seventh month Fang Xuanling was dismissed from office.

translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu in the eighth month Zhang Liang, Minister of the Ministry of Works, was appointed Minister of the Ministry of Justice and participated in court governance.

translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei in the tenth month he established lodges for various prefectures in the capital.

translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi Fang Xuanling resumed office after mourning.

translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao in the eleventh month he performed the suburban sacrifice at the southern altar.

translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the fourth month he went to Jiucheng Palace.

translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu in the seventh month Zhang Jian, military governor of Yingzhou, led troops of You and Ying prefectures along with the Khitan and Xi to attack Goguryeo.

translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao he feasted the elders of Yongzhou at the Shanglin Park and granted grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，如洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, he went to Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin he went to Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，獵于天池。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, he hunted at Tianchi.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi he hunted at Tianchi.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the eleventh month, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin in the eleventh month he reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，遣使巡問鄭、汝、懷、澤四州高年，宴賜之。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, envoys were dispatched to visit and inquire after the elderly in the four prefectures of Zheng, Ru, Huai, and Ze, feasting and granting them gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen he dispatched envoys to visit and inquire after the elderly in the four prefectures of Zheng, Ru, Huai, and Ze, feasting and granting them gifts.

sentences.zh: 甲午，張亮為平壤道行軍大總管，李世勣、馬周為遼東道行軍大總管，率十六總管兵以伐高麗。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Zhang Liang was made grand marching commander of the Pyongyang route; Li Shiji and Ma Zhou were made grand marching commanders of the Liaodong route; they led the forces of sixteen commanders to attack Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu Zhang Liang was appointed grand marching commander of the Pyongyang route; Li Shiji and Ma Zhou were appointed grand marching commanders of the Liaodong route; they led the forces of sixteen commanders to attack Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，庶人承乾卒。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the twelfth month, the commoner Chengqian died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin in the twelfth month the commoner Chengqian died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，李思摩部落叛。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the tribes of Li Simo rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu the tribes of Li Simo rebelled.

sentences.zh: 十九年二月庚戌，如洛陽宮，以伐高麗。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu in the second month of the nineteenth year, he went to Luoyang Palace to campaign against Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu in the second month of the nineteenth year he went to Luoyang Palace to campaign against Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，射虎于武德北山。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, he shot a tiger at the north mountain of Wude.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou he shot a tiger at the north mountain of Wude.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，皇太子監國于定州。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the crown prince served as regent at Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao the crown prince served as regent at Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賜所過高年鰥寡粟帛，贈比干太師，謚忠烈。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, grain and cloth were granted to the elderly, widowed, and orphaned along the route; Bi Gan was posthumously granted the title Grand Preceptor with the posthumous name Zhonglie.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi he granted grain and cloth to the elderly, widowed, and orphaned along the route, and posthumously granted Bi Gan the title Grand Preceptor with the posthumous name Zhonglie.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，長孫無忌攝侍中，吏部尚書楊師道攝中書令。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the third month, Zhangsun Wuji served as acting Palace Attendant, and Yang Shidao, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, served as acting Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen in the third month Zhangsun Wuji served as acting Palace Attendant, and Yang Shidao, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, served as acting Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月癸卯，誓師于幽州，大饗軍。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the fourth month, he took the army oath at Youzhou and held a great feast for the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the fourth month he took the army oath at Youzhou and held a great feast for the troops.

sentences.zh: 丁未，岑文本薨。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Cen Wenben died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei Cen Wenben died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，李世勣克蓋牟城。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Li Shiji captured Gaimou City.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai Li Shiji captured Gaimou City.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，平壤道行軍總管程名振克沙卑城。

translations.literal: On the day jisi in the fifth month, Cheng Mingzhen, marching commander of the Pyongyang route, captured Shabei City.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi in the fifth month Cheng Mingzhen, marching commander of the Pyongyang route, captured Shabei City.

sentences.zh: 庚午，次遼澤，瘞隋人戰亡者。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, he halted at Liaomarsh and buried Sui people who died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu he halted at Liaomarsh and buried the Sui dead from battle.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遼東道行軍總管張君乂有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Zhang Junyi, marching commander of the Liaodong route, was guilty and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai Zhang Junyi, marching commander of the Liaodong route, was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，軍于馬首山。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the army encamped at Mount Mashou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou the army encamped at Mount Mashou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，克遼東城。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Liaodong City was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen Liaodong City was captured.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，克白巖城。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the sixth month, Baiyan City was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou in the sixth month Baiyan City was captured.

sentences.zh: 己未，大敗高麗于安市城東南山，左武衛將軍王君愕死之。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Goguryeo was heavily defeated at the southeastern hills of Anshi City; General of the Left Martial Guards Wang Jun'e died in the engagement.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei he inflicted a great defeat on Goguryeo at the southeastern hills of Anshi City; General of the Left Martial Guards Wang Jun'e died in the battle.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, a three-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou he granted a three-day communal feast.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，葬死事官，加爵四級，以一子襲。

translations.literal: On the day renshen in the seventh month, officials who died in service were buried; four ranks of nobility were added, with one son inheriting.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen in the seventh month he buried officials who died in service, adding four ranks of nobility with one son permitted to inherit.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，班師。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the ninth month, the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei in the ninth month he withdrew the army.

sentences.zh: 十月丙午，次營州，以太牢祭死事者。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the tenth month, he halted at Yingzhou and sacrificed with an ox, sheep, and pig to those who died in service.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu in the tenth month he halted at Yingzhou and made a grand sacrifice to those who died in service.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，皇太子迎謁于臨渝關。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the crown prince met and received him at Linyu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen the crown prince met and received him at Linyu Pass.

sentences.zh: 戊午，次漢武臺，刻石紀功。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, he halted at Hanwu Terrace and had stelae carved to record the achievement.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu he halted at Hanwu Terrace and had stelae carved to commemorate the victory.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，大饗軍于幽州。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the eleventh month, a great feast was held for the army at Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou in the eleventh month he held a great feast for the army at Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，次易州。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, he halted at Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen he halted at Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，平壤道行軍總管張文幹有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Zhang Wengan, marching commander of the Pyongyang route, was guilty and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei Zhang Wengan, marching commander of the Pyongyang route, was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，次定州。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, he halted at Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu he halted at Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，貶楊師道為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Yang Shidao was demoted to Minister of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai Yang Shidao was demoted to Minister of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，次并州。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the twelfth month, he halted at Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen in the twelfth month he halted at Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，薛延陀寇夏州，左領軍大將軍執失思力敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Xue Yantuo raided Xiazhou; Grand General of the Left Army Zhi Shi Sili defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei Xue Yantuo raided Xiazhou, and Grand General of the Left Army Zhi Shi Sili defeated them.

sentences.zh: 庚申，殺劉洎。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Liu Ji was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen Liu Ji was executed.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月辛未，夏州都督喬師望及薛延陀戰，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the first month of the twentieth year, Qiao Shiwang, military governor of Xiazhou, fought Xue Yantuo and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei in the first month of the twentieth year Qiao Shiwang, military governor of Xiazhou, fought Xue Yantuo and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣使二十二人，以六條黜陟于天下。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, twenty-two envoys were dispatched to conduct promotion and demotion throughout the realm by the Six Canons.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou he dispatched twenty-two envoys to conduct promotions and demotions throughout the realm by the Six Canons.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，赦并州，起義時編戶給復三年，後附者一年。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Bingzhou was granted amnesty; registered households at the time of the uprising were granted tax exemption for three years, later arrivals for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen he granted amnesty to Bingzhou; registered households present at the uprising received three years' tax exemption, later arrivals one year.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，從伐高麗無功者，皆賜勳一轉。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the second month, all who followed the campaign against Goguryeo without merit were granted one degree of merit.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu in the second month he granted one degree of merit to all who had joined the Goguryeo campaign without achieving distinction.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賜所過高年鰥寡粟。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, grain was granted to the elderly, widowed, and orphaned along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen he granted grain to the elderly, widowed, and orphaned along the route.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，至自高麗。

translations.literal: On the day jisi in the third month, he returned from Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi in the third month he returned from Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 庚午，不豫，皇太子聽政。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, he fell ill, and the crown prince assumed governance.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu he fell ill and the crown prince assumed governance.

sentences.zh: 己丑，張亮謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Zhang Liang plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou Zhang Liang plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day guisi of the intercalary month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day guisi of the intercalary month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，江夏郡王道宗、李世勣伐薛延陀。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the sixth month, Prince of Jiangxia Commandery Daozong and Li Shiji attacked Xue Yantuo.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai in the sixth month Prince of Jiangxia Commandery Daozong and Li Shiji attacked Xue Yantuo.

sentences.zh: 七月辛亥，疾愈。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the seventh month, his illness was cured.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the seventh month he recovered from his illness.

sentences.zh: 李世勣及薛延陀戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Li Shiji fought Xue Yantuo and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiji engaged Xue Yantuo in battle and routed them.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，封孫忠為陳王。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the eighth month, Sun Zhong was enfeoffed as Prince of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi in the eighth month Sun Zhong was enfeoffed as Prince of Chen.

sentences.zh: 己巳，如靈州。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, he went to Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi he went to Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，次涇州，賜高年鰥寡粟帛。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, he halted at Jingzhou and granted grain and cloth to the elderly, widowed, and orphaned.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen he halted at Jingzhou and granted grain and cloth to the elderly, widowed, and orphaned.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，踰隴山關，次瓦亭，觀馬牧。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, he crossed Longshan Pass, halted at Wating, and inspected the horse pastures.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu he crossed Longshan Pass, halted at Wating, and inspected the horse pastures.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，許陪陵者子孫從葬。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, descendants of those who attended at the imperial tomb were permitted to be buried alongside.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai he permitted descendants of those who attended at the imperial tomb to be buried alongside.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，遣使巡察嶺南。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao in the ninth month, envoys were dispatched to inspect Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao in the ninth month he dispatched envoys to inspect Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，鐵勒諸部請上號為「可汗」。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Tiele tribes requested that the Emperor be titled "Khan."
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen the Tiele tribes requested that he accept the title "Khan."

sentences.zh: 辛亥，靈州地震。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Lingzhou was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai an earthquake struck Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月，貶蕭瑀為商州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Xiao Yu was demoted to prefect of Shangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Xiao Yu was demoted to prefect of Shangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，至自靈州。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, he returned from Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu he returned from Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑，詔：「祭祀、表疏，藩客、兵馬、宿衛行魚契給驛，授五品以上官及除解，決死罪，皆以聞，餘委皇太子。」

translations.literal: On the day jichou in the eleventh month, an edict declared: "Sacrifices, memorials, foreign envoys, troops and horses, palace guards traveling with fish tally for relay horses, the appointment and dismissal of officials of fifth rank and above, and judgment of capital crimes—all are to be reported; the rest is entrusted to the crown prince."
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou in the eleventh month he issued an edict: "Sacrifices, memorials, foreign envoys, troop and horse movements, palace guards traveling with fish tally for relay horses, appointments and dismissals of officials of fifth rank and above, and capital sentences—all must be reported to me; everything else is entrusted to the crown prince."

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月壬辰，高士廉薨。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the first month of the twenty-first year, Gao Shilian died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen in the first month of the twenty-first year Gao Shilian died.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔以來歲二月有事于泰山。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, an edict ordered the feng sacrifice at Mount Tai in the second month of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou he ordered the feng sacrifice at Mount Tai for the second month of the coming year.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以鐵勒諸部為州縣，賜京師酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the Tiele tribes were organized as prefectures and counties; the capital was granted a three-day drinking feast.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin he organized the Tiele tribes as prefectures and counties and granted the capital a three-day communal feast.

sentences.zh: 慮囚，降死罪以下。

translations.literal: Prisoners were reviewed, and all sentences below capital punishment were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: He reviewed prisoners and commuted all sentences below capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，皇太子釋菜于太學。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou in the second month, the crown prince offered vegetables at the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou in the second month the crown prince performed the vegetable offering at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，左武衛大將軍牛進達為青丘道行軍大總管，李世勣為遼東道行軍大總管，率三總管兵以伐高麗。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the third month, Grand General of the Left Martial Guards Niu Jinda was made grand marching commander of the Qingqiu route; Li Shiji was made grand marching commander of the Liaodong route; they led the forces of three grand commanders to attack Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi in the third month Niu Jinda, Grand General of the Left Martial Guards, was appointed grand marching commander of the Qingqiu route and Li Shiji grand marching commander of the Liaodong route; they led the forces of three grand commanders to attack Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 四月乙丑，作翠微宮。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the fourth month, Cuiwei Palace was constructed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou in the fourth month Cuiwei Palace was constructed.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，幸翠微宮。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the fifth month, he visited Cuiwei Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi in the fifth month he visited Cuiwei Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命百司決事于皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, all offices were ordered to decide affairs through the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen he ordered all offices to decide affairs through the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，李世勣克南蘇、木底城。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Li Shiji captured Nansu and Mudi cities.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu Li Shiji captured Nansu and Mudi cities.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，遣使鐵勒諸部購中國人陷沒者。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou in the sixth month, envoys were dispatched to the Tiele tribes to ransom Chinese who had been captured.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou in the sixth month he dispatched envoys to the Tiele tribes to ransom captured Chinese subjects.

sentences.zh: 七月乙未，牛進達克石城。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the seventh month, Niu Jinda captured Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei in the seventh month Niu Jinda captured Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 丙申，作玉華宮。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Yuhua Palace was constructed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen Yuhua Palace was constructed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，至自翠微宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, he returned from Cuiwei Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu he returned from Cuiwei Palace.

sentences.zh: 八月，泉州海溢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the sea overflowed at Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the sea overflowed at Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，停封泰山。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the Mount Tai feng was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu he suspended the Mount Tai feng.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，封子明為曹王。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the ninth month, Ziming was enfeoffed as Prince of Cao.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou in the ninth month Ziming was enfeoffed as Prince of Cao.

sentences.zh: 十月癸丑，褚遂良罷。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the tenth month, Chu Suiliang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou in the tenth month Chu Suiliang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，進封泰為濮王。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the eleventh month, Tai was advanced to Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the eleventh month Tai was advanced to Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，左驍衛大將軍契苾何力為崑丘道行軍大總管，率三總管兵以伐龜茲。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the twelfth month, Qibi Heli, Grand General of the Left Valiant Guards, was made grand marching commander of the Kunqiu route; he led the forces of three grand commanders to attack Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin in the twelfth month Qibi Heli, Grand General of the Left Valiant Guards, was appointed grand marching commander of the Kunqiu route and led the forces of three grand commanders to attack Kucha.

sentences.zh: 二十二年正月庚寅，馬周薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the first month of the twenty-second year, Ma Zhou died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin in the first month of the twenty-second year Ma Zhou died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，幸溫湯。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, he visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu he visited the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，中書舍人崔仁師為中書侍郎，參知機務。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Cui Renshi, Secretariat Drafting Officer, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and participated in deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai Cui Renshi, Secretariat Drafting Officer, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat to participate in deliberation on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，左武衛大將軍薛萬徹為青丘道行軍大總管，以伐高麗。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Xue Wanche, Grand General of the Left Martial Guards, was made grand marching commander of the Qingqiu route to attack Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu Xue Wanche, Grand General of the Left Martial Guards, was appointed grand marching commander of the Qingqiu route to attack Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 長孫無忌檢校中書令，知尚書、門下省事。

translations.literal: Zhangsun Wuji was appointed acting Director of the Secretariat and managed the affairs of the Department of State Affairs and the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangsun Wuji was appointed acting Director of the Secretariat and took charge of the Department of State Affairs and the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊申，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen he returned from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 二月，褚遂良起復。

translations.literal: In the second month, Chu Suiliang resumed office after mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Chu Suiliang resumed office after mourning.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，見京城父老，勞之，蠲今歲半租，畿縣三之一。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, he received the elders of the capital, comforted them, remitted half the year's land tax, and one-third in the metropolitan counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao he received the elders of the capital, comforted them, remitted half the year's land tax, and one-third in the metropolitan counties.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔度遼水有功未酬勳而犯罪者與成官同。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, an edict declared that those with uncredited merit for crossing the Liao River who committed crimes should receive the same treatment as those whose merit had been fully rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao he decreed that officials with uncredited merit for crossing the Liao River who committed crimes should receive the same leniency as those whose merits had already been fully rewarded.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，幸玉華宮。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, he visited Yuhua Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai he visited Yuhua Palace.

sentences.zh: 己卯，獵于華原。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, he hunted at Huayuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao he hunted at Huayuan.

sentences.zh: 流崔仁師于連州。

translations.literal: Cui Renshi was exiled to Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Renshi was banished to Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，赦宜君，給復縣人自玉華宮苑中遷者三年。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the third month, Yijun was granted amnesty; county people relocated from the Yuhua Palace grounds were granted tax exemption for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai in the third month he granted amnesty to Yijun and granted three years' tax exemption to county people relocated from the Yuhua Palace grounds.

sentences.zh: 四月丁巳，松州蠻叛，右武候將軍梁建方敗之。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the fourth month, the barbarians of Songzhou rebelled; General of the Right Martial Guards Liang Jianfang defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the fourth month the barbarians of Songzhou rebelled, and General of the Right Martial Guards Liang Jianfang defeated them.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，張行成存問河北從軍者家，令州縣為營農。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin in the sixth month, Zhang Xingcheng visited and inquired after the families of soldiers from Hebei who had joined the army, ordering prefectures and counties to arrange their farming.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin in the sixth month Zhang Xingcheng visited and inquired after the families of Hebei soldiers in service, ordering prefectures and counties to arrange farming for them.

sentences.zh: 丙子，薛萬徹及高麗戰于泊灼城，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Xue Wanche fought Goguryeo at Bozhuo City and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi Xue Wanche fought Goguryeo at Bozhuo City and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 七月甲申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen in the seventh month, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen in the seventh month Venus was visible in daytime.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，殺華州刺史李君羨。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Li Junxian, prefect of Huazhou, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen Li Junxian, prefect of Huazhou, was executed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，房玄齡薨。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Fang Xuanling died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao Fang Xuanling died.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day jiyou of the eighth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day jiyou of the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛未，執失思力伐薛延陀餘部于金山。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Zhi Shi Sili attacked the remnant forces of Xue Yantuo at Jinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei Zhi Shi Sili attacked the remnant forces of Xue Yantuo at Jinshan.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰，崑丘道行軍總管阿史那社爾及薛延陀餘部處月、處蜜戰，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the ninth month, Ashina She'er, marching commander of the Kunqiu route, fought the Chuyue and Chumi, remnant forces of Xue Yantuo, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen in the ninth month Ashina She'er, marching commander of the Kunqiu route, fought the Chuyue and Chumi, remnant forces of Xue Yantuo, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 己亥，褚遂良為中書令。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Chu Suiliang was made Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai Chu Suiliang was appointed Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，眉、邛、雅三州獠反，茂州都督張士貴討之。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the Liao of the three prefectures of Mei, Qiong, and Ya rebelled; Zhang Shigui, military governor of Maozhou, attacked them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin the Liao of the three prefectures of Mei, Qiong, and Ya rebelled, and Zhang Shigui, military governor of Maozhou, attacked them.

sentences.zh: 十月癸丑，至自玉華宮。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the tenth month, he returned from Yuhua Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou in the tenth month he returned from Yuhua Palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，阿史那社爾及龜茲戰，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Ashina She'er fought Kucha and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi Ashina She'er fought Kucha and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，降長安、萬年徒罪以下。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the twelfth month, all sentences below penal servitude in Chang'an and Wannian were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei in the twelfth month he commuted all sentences below penal servitude in Chang'an and Wannian.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸巳，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day guisi of the intercalary month, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi of the intercalary month he reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 二十三年正月辛亥，阿史那社爾俘龜茲王以獻。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the first month of the twenty-third year, Ashina She'er captured the King of Kucha and presented him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the first month of the twenty-third year Ashina She'er captured the King of Kucha and presented him.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，自冬旱，至是雨。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the third month, drought had lasted since winter; rain fell at this time.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei in the third month rain fell, ending the drought that had lasted since winter.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, a general amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou he granted a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，不豫，命皇太子聽政于金液門。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, he fell ill and ordered the crown prince to assume governance at Jinye Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao he fell ill and ordered the crown prince to assume governance at Jinye Gate.

sentences.zh: 四月己亥，幸翠微宮。

translations.literal: On the day jihai in the fourth month, he visited Cuiwei Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai in the fourth month he visited Cuiwei Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，貶李世勣為疊州都督。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu in the fifth month, Li Shiji was demoted to military governor of Diezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu in the fifth month Li Shiji was demoted to military governor of Diezhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，皇帝崩于含風殿，年五十三。

translations.literal: On jisi the emperor died in the Hall of Gathering Winds, aged fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the emperor died in the Hall of Gathering Winds, at the age of fifty-three.

sentences.zh: 庚午，奉大行御馬輿還京師。

translations.literal: On gengwu the imperial carriage bearing the late emperor was escorted back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the imperial carriage bearing the late emperor was brought back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書于志寧為侍中，太子少詹事張行成兼侍中，高季輔兼中書令。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Yu Zhining became Palace Attendant; Senior Tutor of the Crown Prince Zhang Xingcheng was made concurrent Palace Attendant; and Gao Jifu was made concurrent Director of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Zhining, minister of rites, was appointed palace attendant; Zhang Xingcheng, senior tutor to the crown prince, was made concurrent palace attendant; and Gao Jifu was made concurrent director of the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬申，發喪，謚曰文。

translations.literal: On renshen mourning was proclaimed; his posthumous title was Literary.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the court proclaimed mourning and gave him the posthumous title Literary.

sentences.zh: 上元元年，改謚文武聖皇帝；

translations.literal: In the first year of Shangyuan his posthumous title was changed to Martial and Literary Sage Emperor;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shangyuan his posthumous title was revised to Martial and Literary Sage Emperor;

sentences.zh: 天寶八載，謚文武大聖皇帝；

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tianbao his posthumous title was Martial and Literary Great Sage Emperor;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tianbao he was titled Martial and Literary Great Sage Emperor;

sentences.zh: 十三載，增謚文武大聖大廣孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year his posthumous title was augmented to Martial and Literary Great Sage Greatly Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year his title was further augmented to Martial and Literary Great Sage Greatly Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：甚矣，至治之君不世出也！

translations.literal: The encomium says: How rare it is for a ruler of supreme governance to appear in an age!
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: How seldom does a ruler of supreme governance appear in any age!

sentences.zh: 禹有天下，傳十有六王，而少康有中興之業。

translations.literal: Yu held the realm and passed it through sixteen kings, yet only Shaokang achieved a restoration.
translations.idiomatic: Yu held the realm through sixteen successive kings, yet only Shaokang achieved a true restoration.

sentences.zh: 湯有天下，傳二十八王，而其甚盛者，號稱三宗。

translations.literal: Tang held the realm and passed it through twenty-eight kings; of their greatest flourishing, three are called the Three Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Tang held the realm through twenty-eight kings, and of their greatest age only three are honored as the Three Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 武王有天下，傳三十六王，而成、康之治與宣之功，其餘無所稱焉。

translations.literal: King Wu held the realm and passed it through thirty-six kings; the governance of Cheng and Kang and the achievements of Xuan—beyond these there is little to praise.
translations.idiomatic: King Wu held the realm through thirty-six kings; apart from the reigns of Cheng and Kang and the achievements of King Xuan, little else is worth naming.

sentences.zh: 雖詩、書所載，時有闕略，然三代千有七百餘年，傳七十餘君，其卓然著見於後世者，此六七君而已。

translations.literal: Though what the Odes and Documents record is sometimes incomplete, across the Three Dynasties' more than seventeen hundred years and seventy-odd rulers, only these six or seven stand out clearly to later ages.
translations.idiomatic: Though the Odes and Documents are sometimes incomplete, across the Three Dynasties' seventeen hundred years and more than seventy rulers, only six or seven stand out clearly to posterity.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，可謂難得也！

translations.literal: Alas, how hard they are to obtain!
translations.idiomatic: Alas—how rare they are!

sentences.zh: 唐有天下，傳世二十，其可稱者三君，玄宗、憲宗皆不克其終，盛哉，太宗之烈也！

translations.literal: Tang held the realm for twenty generations; three rulers may be praised. Xuanzong and Xianzong both failed to finish well—how magnificent was Taizong's achievement!
translations.idiomatic: Tang held the realm for twenty generations, and only three rulers truly merit praise. Xuanzong and Xianzong both failed to end well—how magnificent was Taizong's achievement!

sentences.zh: 其除隋之亂，比跡湯、武；

translations.literal: In removing Sui disorder he may be compared with Tang and Wu;
translations.idiomatic: In sweeping away Sui disorder he stands comparison with Tang and Wu;

sentences.zh: 致治之美，庶幾成、康。

translations.literal: The beauty of his governance nearly matched Cheng and Kang.
translations.idiomatic: The excellence of his governance nearly matched the age of Cheng and Kang.

sentences.zh: 自古功德兼隆，由漢以來未之有也。

translations.literal: From antiquity, merit and virtue together so lofty—since Han there has been nothing like it.
translations.idiomatic: Never since antiquity had merit and virtue been joined on such a scale; nothing like it had been seen since the Han.

sentences.zh: 至其牽於多愛，復立浮圖，好大喜功，勤兵於遠，此中材庸主之所常為。

translations.literal: As for his entanglement in many attachments, his restoration of Buddhist establishments, his love of grand achievements, and his exertion of arms in distant lands—these are what mediocre rulers commonly do.
translations.idiomatic: Yet his entanglement in many attachments, his restoration of Buddhist establishments, his love of grand achievements, and his campaigns in distant lands are the sort of thing mediocre rulers commonly do.

sentences.zh: 然春秋之法，常責備於賢者，是以後世君子之欲成人之美者，莫不歎息於斯焉。

translations.literal: Yet the method of the Spring and Autumn Annals is often to hold the worthy to strict account; therefore gentlemen of later ages who wished to complete another's excellence have all sighed at this.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Spring and Autumn Annals habitually hold the worthy to a stricter standard; and so later gentlemen who sought to complete another's excellence have all sighed over these very faults.
